evidence.quote: Unprecedented AI compute power of 26 Tera-Operations Per Second (TOPS)
The Hailo-8 Industrial Version IC is replacing the discontinued Hailo-8 Commercial Version IC.

notes.zh: 回答低功耗视觉推理模块的算力与功耗档位：片上自带内存、不需要外挂 DRAM 是它区别于大算力卡的关键约束。不回答它能跑哪些大语言模型：官方定位为视觉与神经网络推理，选型前要核对模型是否在支持列表内。商用版本芯片已由官方公告停产、改由工业版本替代，采购时需确认版本。
notes.en: Answers the compute and power tier of a low-power vision inference module, whose defining constraint is on-chip memory with no external DRAM. It does not answer which large language models it can run: the vendor positions it for vision and neural-network inference, so model support must be checked against the supported list first. The vendor has announced end-of-life for the commercial version IC, replaced by the industrial version, so the variant must be confirmed when ordering.

specs.memory: integrated on-chip, no external DRAM required
specs.frameworks: TensorFlow, TensorFlow Lite, Keras, PyTorch, ONNX
